description: Resolve financial instrument identifiers — ISIN, CUSIP, SEDOL, or ticker symbol to Bloomberg FIGI (ISO 18774). Returns FIGI, composite FIGI, security name, type, and exchange. 300M+ instruments across 45K+ exchanges. Use ID_ISIN, ID_CUSIP, ID_SEDOL, or TICKER as id_type.

exchange_code.description: Exchange code to narrow results (e.g. US, LN, JP). Optional.

id_type.description: Identifier type: ID_ISIN, ID_CUSIP, ID_SEDOL, TICKER, ID_BB_GLOBAL

id_value.description: Identifier value (e.g. US0378331005 for ISIN, AAPL for ticker, BBG000B9XRY4 for FIGI)

name: figi.finance.map

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Map Financial Identifier to FIGI
